name: ver02-c1-grapple-transition
description: S6 checkpoint C1 / VER-02, scene-transition terminal for the single-link native grapple owner. A fresh process from the disposable fixture has an Expanded Summoning crocodile hold a party companion (created through the engine's persistent-party path) and the party take the area's only exit through the engine's AreaTransitionGroupCommand.ExecuteTransition; the companion is checked right after the leave event and in the arrival area after loading. The probe refuses a scripted or restricted exit rather than drive unexpected UI. In KMCS_AFTER_NORMAL_012_MODONLY the only exit (JamandisMansionThroneroom_exitTransition) is scripted, so this session is refused there (20261122T200003Z launch 3); it needs a fixture with an unscripted exit.
